placement_after: Buddy got up and tried one careful step beside him. Neet stopped dancing to correct it, immediately less homesick.
alt_text: Neet pauses his grand dance to correct Buddy’s tentative first step.
scene_brief: Warm suburban living room after return to U.S. television far left shows only abstract colorful dance silhouettes, no real actor likeness. Neet on rug in theatrical but anatomically natural playbow with one front paw lifted, turned to inspect Buddy beside him. Buddy is trying one careful dance step: three paws on rug, one forepaw tentatively lifted, full connected body. Contrasting confident impatient coach and tentative willing companion. No humanoid upright dancing, no extra limbs. Low sofa/background lamp, no humans necessary.
